value.value: Selected M1-M3, M7, S1 and A1-A2 powders are packed in rotating 0.3 mm glass capillaries at SPring-8 BL44B2. Debye-Scherrer geometry and an image plate are used. The reported wavelength includes parenthetic uncertainty; CeO2 supplies resolution and wavelength calibration.

value.value: MAUD models a background combining four polynomial functions and two features for small-angle scattering/glass. Three spherical-harmonic functions represent anisotropic size broadening. For all laboratory-sample data, positions and occupancies are fixed to literature values; atom-type ADPs are refined as defect/disorder proxies and microstrain is not modeled.
